structured.answer: Open a trading account at Pesagot (פסגות ניירות ערך) and buy the IBI tracker fund "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125" every month. The page marks it as the cheapest pair, ending at 86,045 ₪ after 10 years.

stuck.why: My chosen fund shows '-0.04%' and the others show '-1,030 ₪'. Minus signs everywhere, and I wasn't sure whether minus meant bad
Pesagot is first, but it isn't a bank I know. I hesitated before trusting it over Leumi
The defaults are 10,000 and 500, not my 30,000, so the shekel numbers aren't really mine. I didn't change them

stuck.where: Line chart 'מה הכי משנה את מה שיישאר לכם'

findings.what: Minus signs on the good fund ('-0.04%') and on the alternatives ('-1,030 ₪') make it hard to tell what's good and what's bad
findings.where: Fund list 'כל הקרנות על מדד ת"א-125'

findings.what: The top recommendation is a non-bank name I'm unsure about. Nothing says whether it's safe
Lots of unexplained jargon tags on each fund (צוברת, מחזיקה את המניות, כמה דרכים יחד)
Defaults (10,000 / 500) aren't my numbers, so the big shekel figures don't feel like mine
Fee bars are coloured, but the legend is far away (top of screen 2 / bottom of list)
No obvious 'what to do next' step after the recommendation
The line chart with four coloured lines is hard to read on a phone
